subject.title: feat(skills): per-agent autonomous evolution policy and one-shot proposal review notices

question: Should autonomous Skill Workshop enrollment become a new capture-specific per-agent config contract, or derive from an existing agent policy surface?
rationale: This establishes a permanent public configuration boundary for a newly introduced core feature, and repository evidence cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Keep capture-specific policy
options.body: Retain allow/deny, canonicalize agent IDs, and document precedence relative to effective tool availability.

options.title: Derive from tool policy
options.body: Use effective skill_workshop availability as enrollment and avoid adding the two new config keys.

options.title: Defer enrollment controls
options.body: Remove the per-agent policy from this PR until the base Skill Workshop contracts stabilize.

recommendation.title: Keep capture-specific policy
recommendation.body: Retain allow/deny, canonicalize agent IDs, and document precedence relative to effective tool availability.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current-main Skill Workshop behavior and is the strongest history-backed owner for its next public contract.
